events.text:
I'm working through the coding: sepsis due to E. coli as A41.51, severe sepsis without shock as R65.20, plus AKI, metabolic encephalopathy, and UTI codes, noting B96.20 still applies for the organism alongside A41.51, and settling on E11.9 for diabetes since hyperglycemia wasn't explicitly documented as linked.

Lactic acidosis is trickier — I'm weighing whether it's integral to sepsis or separately codable; it's documented as organ dysfunction so I'll tentatively include E87.29 with lower confidence given the ambiguity. Pyelonephritis only appears as "likely" in the H&P but not at discharge,

R65.20: Severe sepsis without septic shock (billable)
N39.0: Urinary tract infection, site not specified (billable)

E11.9: Type 2 diabetes mellitus without complications (billable)
Z79.84: Long term (current) use of oral hypoglycemic drugs (billable)
